hero.subtitle: From first draft to published post, Markaestro handles every step of your social workflow. One platform, zero context-switching.

coreFeatures.title: Multi-Channel Publishing
coreFeatures.description: Compose once, publish everywhere. Write a single post and adapt it for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, and Pinterest in one click. Schedule for optimal timing or publish instantly.

coreFeatures.title: Media Upload & Library
coreFeatures.description: Bring your own photography, video, and brand assets. Markaestro stores them per workspace and attaches them to posts with a single drop.
details: JPG, PNG, WebP, MP4, MOV, and WebM support
Up to 250 MB per video, 10 MB per image
Reuse uploaded media across multiple posts

coreFeatures.title: Multi-Channel Previews
coreFeatures.description: See how every post will look on each network before you publish: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, and Pinterest each get their own preview. Captions, aspect ratios, character limits, and media specs are all rendered live.
details: Catch formatting issues before they ship

coreFeatures.title: Publishing Dashboard
coreFeatures.description: See every draft, scheduled post, and publishing state in one workspace view without jumping between platforms.

coreFeatures.title: OAuth Integrations
coreFeatures.description: Connect your accounts in one click with industry-standard OAuth. No manual API keys, no token juggling. Markaestro securely stores and refreshes credentials for you.
details: One-click connect for Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, and Pinterest

coreFeatures.title: API & AI Agents
coreFeatures.description: Everything the dashboard does, your software can do too. Mint an API key, hand it to an AI agent or a script, and let it discover accounts, upload media, schedule posts, publish, and report back, on every plan, at no extra cost.
details: Keys scoped to a single brand, with optional expiry
Idempotent writes so a retry never double-posts
Async publish runs plus HMAC-signed webhooks
Manual-first on Meta and TikTok: a human still posts
coreFeatures.codeLabel: schedule a post from anything that speaks HTTP

platformFeatures.title: Workspace Management
platformFeatures.description: Organize the brands you market, clients, business units, or your own ventures, into isolated workspaces. Each workspace has its own brands, integrations, and team members.

platformFeatures.title: Scheduling & Calendar
platformFeatures.description: Queue posts on a unified calendar across all your channels. Reschedule with a drag, duplicate posts in a click, and keep a clear view of what's going out when.

platformFeatures.title: Role-Based Access
platformFeatures.description: Control who can publish, edit, or view with three-tier roles: Owner, Admin, and Member. Keep sensitive settings locked down while your team moves fast.

platformSection.subtitle: Beyond the core tools, Markaestro gives you the infrastructure to scale, from a single brand to a full client roster.

cta.title: Ready to see it in action?
cta.subtitle: Start for free. No credit card required. Connect your first channel in under two minutes.

intelligence.subtitle: Intelligence reads the posts you already published, keeps every metric exactly as the platforms reported it, and turns that history into plain-language answers and ready-to-edit drafts. Nothing posts automatically.

loop.title: Measure
loop.body: Posts published through Markaestro and history imported from your connected accounts become one record per post with the metrics each platform reported. Missing numbers stay blank, never zero.

loop.title: Learn
loop.body: Deterministic statistics compare your posts by platform, time slot, content pillar, hook, and format. A pattern only appears with at least five posts in the group and five outside it, with a 95% range on the effect.

loop.title: Recommend
loop.body: Opportunities turn those findings into concrete next steps with the numbers behind them: a window that beats your average, a platform that wins per post, a pattern worth repeating.

loop.title: Draft
loop.body: Draft this writes a caption in your brand voice from your own best-performing evidence and saves it to Content as a normal draft. You edit, add media, and schedule.

intelligence.tabsTitle: What you get, tab by tab

tabs.title: Overview
tabs.body: Objective banner, measured KPIs, per-post platform comparison, and a readiness list that shows exactly which features are active and how much data each one still needs.

tabs.title: Audience
tabs.body: Declare your objective, markets, timezone, pillars, and voice. Tracked short links count clicks without storing personal data and tie conversions back to the post.

tabs.title: Content
tabs.body: Your posts ranked by the metric you chose, the patterns detected in each one, and a Why it worked explanation grounded in that post's numbers against your account average.

tabs.title: Opportunities
tabs.body: Evidence-backed suggestions you can accept, pin, or dismiss, each with a Draft this button. Accepting never creates or schedules a post.

tabs.title: Playbook
tabs.body: Patterns that repeat in your data with the sample size, effect, and confidence range spelled out in plain words, plus the posts behind each one.

tabs.title: Experiments and Ask
tabs.body: Paired A/B posts with a measured winner, and questions answered only from this brand's records, citing the data used.

principles: Never publishes or schedules on its own. Every action is a draft or a decision you record.
Never fills in a number a platform did not report. Blank means blank.
Never uses other brands' data or generic benchmarks. Every claim comes from your own history.
Always says what fed a result: Measured, Calculated, Recommended, Declared, or Generated.
intelligence.plans: Audience Fit is on every plan. Playbook, Opportunities, tracked links, and Ask Markaestro start on Pro; Experiments on Business. AI actions such as Draft this are metered per month by plan.
intelligence.cta: Start free and connect a channel
